profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am passionate about building a bridge the technology world to the business world and build the best product that serves the community.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
- Drove collaborative efforts to develop new features to automate canceling shipments containing defective inventory that eliminated defective inventory leakages, canceling ~10k customer orders yearly
- Lead teams of 2-3 engineers to consistently deliver 4 cross-functional team projects by providing technical designs with actionable tasks and timelines
- Implemented new data hierarchies to represent bulk inventory for Inbound team as away team engineer
- Implemented operational improvements on teams’ service through cache and exponential retries, decreasing paging occurrences from dependencies by 80%

positions.title: Software Development Engineer I
positions.description: - Designed and implemented new APIs to stop defective inventory movements in fulfillment centers, serving ~20k customer requests impacting ~1 million units yearly

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
●	Evaluated students’ performance by grading monthly quizzes and tests
●	Assisted students in understanding fundamentals of discrete math and algorithms by holding weekly office hours

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
●	Implemented a service called Maia that manages issuance of Airbnb Employee Travel Credit in Java
●	Addressed shortcomings of the existing service in efficiency and incompatibility with other microservices 
●	Collaborated with another engineer to allow Maia to manages issuance of credit for customer support agents
●	Collaborated with other engineering teams to build necessary API endpoints that are needed by Maia
●	Established documentation and developer guide for future usage

positions.title: Engineering Practicum Intern
positions.description:
●	Developed a web application to show failure handler’s configuration and past states of failure diagnosis system 
●	Designed, implemented and tested both user interface and back end of the web application using C++ and Python
●	Conducted interviews and demo sessions to improve customers' experience with key features of the site
●	Decreased engineers’ time to find details of hardware failures by 80% and improved communication with site reliability engineers’ team

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Intern
positions.description:
●	Designed and implemented user interface for creating networked program
●	Built a chart drawing tool using Chart.js library, the first API of its kind in Netsblox
●	Added 3 APIs to help users get data from outside sources such as Weather.com, IMDB using Node.js
●	Enabled students to build more applications like weather report and stock report using the new APIs and tools
